correctness.rationale: Rate-one per-type Poissonization gives E[tau|labels]=T/n and E tau=H_n, so Cov(T,C)=n Cov(tau,C). Marking the final type and tilting the max of n-1 exponential first-arrival times by exp(-t) identifies the auxiliary Beta(2,n-1) law and sum of rates 2..n. The exact mixed-moment identity follows. Strict moment log-convexity makes R_r=mu_(r+1)/mu_r strictly increasing, R_1<H_n and R_r->infinity, giving a single sign transition. The centered variable Y-log n has limiting gamma-log MGF Gamma(2-t) for t<2; uniform exponential moments justify r/log n->alpha<2 tilt and threshold alpha=1. Independent exact moment arithmetic showed sign sequences n=2,3,5 including zero at (2,2).
